data.body: [P2] Cover the release-branch gate with regression tests. CONTRIBUTING.md rule 4 requires tests that fail when an added condition is removed or inverted. No test exercises this gate: the existing publish tests cover dist-tag decisions and the publishing script, while the reported manual checks cover accepted tags only. CI would remain green if this check accepted unrelated commits or rejected valid `v1.x` releases. Per rule 9, return to the design phase and include executable coverage for both allowed branches, an unrelated commit, and a colliding `origin/main` tag.
